data.one_liner: A Flutter popup anchor widget for picking dates and times using a Cupertino-style spinner.
data.what_it_does: It shows an animated popup anchor that lets users select a date or time via a Cupertino-style spinner. It supports configuration for minimum and max times, minute intervals, custom text, and localization delegates.
use_when: You need a date or time picker that displays inside a popup anchor.
You prefer a Cupertino-style spinner picker for date and time selection.
avoid_when: You need a standard Material DatePicker or TimePicker dialog.
You are building an app that does not require form pickers.
strengths: Provides both date and time picker modes.
Customizable text, format, and localization support.
Easy integration with standard Material localizations.
weaknesses: Limited to spinner-based Cupertino-style UI layouts.
Few options for complex multi-date ranges.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding standard Material localization delegates if using custom locales.

alternatives.name: calendar_date_picker2
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need a calendar-style date picker instead of a Cupertino spinner.

data.minimal_example:
TimePickerSpinnerPopUp(
  mode: CupertinoDatePickerMode.time,
  initTime: DateTime.now(),
  onChange: (dateTime) {},
)
